policy_text_full: Costco refunds the price difference if the price of an item drops at Costco within 30 days of purchase. Only Costco's own price drops qualify — competitor matches are not offered. Refund is issued as member account credit; Costco membership is required, and claim path differs for in-warehouse vs. costco.com purchases.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Members can request a price adjustment within 30 days if the price of an item drops at Costco; refund is issued as member account credit.
